---
name: Report a problem
about: What you heard, what you expected, and when
---

**What were you doing?** Step by step, in order.

**What did AVM say?** As close to word for word as you can manage. Just as
important: where did you expect speech and get silence? Silence is a bug
in this project, not the absence of one.

**Was VoiceOver awake or asleep at the time?**

**Roughly what time did it happen?** So it can be matched against the log.

**Your Mac model and macOS version:**

**The diagnostic log.** In AVM, choose File, then Save Diagnostic Log.
Every file in the saved folder is plain text you can read with VoiceOver
before sending. Compress the folder and attach it here. Your Mac user
name is replaced with a tilde, and AVM never records what you type.
